name: Tevash Szat
description: A planeswalker among the Nine Titans who betrayed his fellows to the Phyrexians and was killed by Urza.

description_citations.text: "Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza's Nine Titans enter Phyrexia, but Tevash Szat betrays and kills his fellow planeswalkers until Urza defeats him and uses his life force for soul bombs.
timeline.quote: Tevash Szat began to betray and kill his fellow planeswalkers, turning to the side of the Phyrexians.

citation.text: "Urza", section "Betrayal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Urza defeated Tevash and used his life force for the soul bombs.
relations.quote: Urza was able to defeat him and used the power from his life force
